I submitted the order, and httpbin's response page shows it received everything you specified. I left that page open in its tab.

The response lists these form values:
- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon, cheese (Extra Cheese)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

The time picker ignored my typed input, so I set the delivery field's value directly with a script instead. The submission still recorded 19:45.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

A="agent-browser --session task-8a0d928fe20e"; $A fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace" && $A fill @e3 "555-0100" && $A fill @e4 "ada@example.com" && $A check @e7 && $A check @e8 && $A check @e9 && $A fill @e12 "Ring twice" && $A click @e14 && $A type @e14 "07" && $A type @e15 "45" && $A type @e16 "PM" && $A snapshot -i
